front: {{c1::Pacinian}} corpuscles sense deep pressure/vibration; {{c2::Meissner}} corpuscles light touch; Merkel discs texture; Ruffini endings stretch.

front: What is sensory adaptation?
why: Sensory adaptation definition is foundational outline content
